question: Should OpenClaw now follow StepFun's current guidance and make Step 3.7 Flash the shared default for every fresh standard and Step Plan setup?
rationale: Both models are supported and the implementation is mechanically correct, but the preceding provider landing explicitly chose to preserve Step 3.5, making reversal of that policy a human product decision.

options.title: Adopt Step 3.7 defaults
options.body: Approve the shared Step 3.7 default for all four fresh authentication choices, matching current provider guidance.

options.title: Retain Step 3.5 defaults
options.body: Keep the conservative behavior selected during the predecessor landing and leave Step 3.7 explicitly selectable.

options.title: Stage the change
options.body: Move the standard API default first and defer Step Plan if maintainers prefer a narrower rollout.

recommendation.title: Adopt Step 3.7 defaults
recommendation.body: Approve the shared Step 3.7 default for all four fresh authentication choices, matching current provider guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They explicitly selected and landed the current default policy during review of the immediately preceding StepFun change.
